items.comments: Place was great! Near everything and the coffee shops and restaurants down stairs were awesome.  Had dinner on the balcony one night and loved the pool table and fire pits. Only complaint would be Amazon construction across the street, but wouldn't start until about 9am.
The unit was very nicely decorated, clean and quiet. Great location, walking distance to all the sights. We enjoyed our stay.
Condo was as described. Zero hassles. Decent neighborhood and located in a central location. Felt like a home. Good experience all around.
